_: Signature clusters, made by comparing the inscription images. The transcribed `hand` field in candidates.json was used only as corroboration, since it splits one person across several spellings (Roth / Roth, Wisler; Hohnrich / Hohmüller / Hohn). The commonest trap is the Kurrent long s, which reads as pf or as f and makes one hand look like two. `reading` is what the cluster's clearest specimen seems to say, not an identification. A roll carrying two hands appears under both.

clusters.note: One hand writing its s two ways: the Kurrent long s, tall and descending, until early 1911, and the round Latin s from April 1911 on. Constant throughout are the double-arch W, the bar over the i and the terminal -er. 1909-1913.
Ornate F with a horizontal top bar. Writes the month as a word (Novb, Dezb, Jan, Febr). Nov 1908 - Feb 1909. This is the hand of roll 225.
Broad nib, heavily looped and intertwined, signed without a roll number on some. 1904-1909. Distinct from the fine M. Schäfer.
Looped K, terminal f crossed by a slash. Five of these were transcribed only as an illegible word or name.
Two-stroke H with a looped left arm. Transcribed variously as Hohnrich, Hohmüller, Hohnreich and Hohn; the letterforms are one hand. 1908-1912.
Looped K, umlaut over the a. 1909-1912.
Looped K with a curved left arm, long terminal stroke. 1907-1910.
An abbreviation, not a full name: a large looped initial and two short letters. 1913.
Fine copperplate, no roll number and no date. The initial was read once as C and once as J; it is the same glyph.
Fine copperplate, written along the roll rather than across it. No date.
G with a deep descending loop, long flat terminal. Jan-Mar 1909.

A Kurrent name opening with a tall descending ligature, then -legel with a looped l. The ligature reads as Sch or as Pfl, so the name is equally Schlegel or Pflugel; on rb625rv7300 it follows the words Hans u. 1909-1919.

A short pencil word: hooked initial, a narrow letter under a diacritic, a tall looped ascender. The only pencil hand among the early rolls. Read as M. W. here and as Wild on sr504pc8797, neither securely. Oct 1907 - Apr 1908.
